items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 August 2026 5:02am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 26 August 2026 at 4:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

A shallow slow-moving low in sea area Plymouth bringing a front across the area.


##Wind##

East 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 this afternoon, then occasionally 5 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate becoming slight this afternoon.


##Weather##

Occasional rain slowly spreading across the area from the southwest, becoming mainly fair later this evening or early tonight.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in places, backing north or northeast 2 to 4 Thursday afternoon. Further backing northwest 4 occasionally 5 overnight into Friday.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then rain developing Thursday afternoon, heavy in places.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.
